body: Orchestrator, row 4 check: `src/main/agents/adapters/acpProcess.test.ts` › "keeps only the tail of a long stderr" fails on main HEAD 88c212f (the epic's start commit, in the space-epic worktree) the same way it fails on space-sprint-1: the closed message lacks THE-END. No SPACE ticket touches acpProcess.ts. Row 4's first check ran all of src/main/agents and failed only on this test. The recorded rerun excludes that one file, and every test that touches row 4's files passes. The full `npm test` at DM-273 and the acceptance node will still hit it: DM-273 must fix it, or the person must decide.
